summary: Geopolitical alerts that can move oil. Scans every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

netRead.bottom: New Hormuz ship-fire report, Saudi facility fires, Iraq unrest, Israel's reported Iran strike prep and Ust-Luga damage skew higher; Saudi output and US diplomacy offset.

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: Satellite imagery reportedly shows fires at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu Industrial City and Shedgum gas plant, and an unconfirmed fresh ship fire in the Strait of Hormuz this afternoon.

Kan reports Israel is preparing a possible Iran strike despite reported Trump resistance, initial reports describe Baghdad Green Zone clashes, and Russia's seaborne crude exports fell about 700,000 b/d.
